csv_scope_of_work: The Birmingham Airport Authority (BAA) is soliciting Statements of Qualifications (SOQ) and Project Proposals from qualified airport planning firms (firms) for professional services associated with airport terminal and land side planning. The selected firm shall be obligated to perform the necessary work involved in an airport master plan through project completion. The selected firm will need to be familiar with the airport master plan process, guidance, advisory circulars and best practices to deliver a comprehensive study and report for the Birmingham-Shuttlesworth International Airport (BHM).
